a: browserReservedChord never reports the tab-switching chords, and on Apple can never report a chord that needs Ctrl
handleDrag and thresholdDrag keep a drag open across a window blur, and later commit it, where carry and the dispatcher cancel
startThresholdDrag reports a missed release below the threshold as a click
b: A carry whose release went unseen drops its payload at the next move's point
`undoKeyStep` takes a text field inside a shadow root for a non-editable target and hands its Cmd+Z to the page
`useHandleDrag` measures its box once, so a scroll during the drag shifts every reported point
The reserved-chord table cannot express Ctrl+Tab, so the tab switcher's chords are never reported
`startThresholdDrag` takes and releases its late capture itself, beside the session's own `capture()`
